messages:
tom_support: Escalating HelixCare onboarding to CS. Account HC-77, ARR =~$210k. Onboarding stuck: 429 rate_limit and 422 schema errors during patient batch ingest. Renewal nudges in ~2.5 weeks. Need CS to own bridge + comms plan; customer is worried about go-live.

tom_support: Quick context: onboarding started 2026-02-28, they've retried several batches and see intermittent 429s and a recurring validation failure for `patient.address.zip`. Sometimes token exchange returns 401.

mia_cs: Thanks Tom. I'll take lead. Can someone paste representative errors and any recent config changes? We'll request a 20-30m troubleshooting session today.

tom_support: Error samples:
```
2026-04-08T13:02:11Z ERROR api: request failed acct=HC-77 code=429 reason="rate_limit_exceeded: per_org_per_minute"
2026-04-08T13:03:02Z WARN validate: payload 422 field=patient.address.zip reason="regex_mismatch"
2026-04-08T13:03:05Z ERROR auth: oauth exchange failed acct=HC-77 code=401 detail="invalid_refresh_token"
```
Also saw a 3x bump in concurrent uploads starting 12:58Z.

alert-bot: [incident] Created P1 case INC-2026-221 for HC-77 assigned to customer-success. SLA: 2 business hours for initial outreach.

raj_se: Likely a combination: client-side schema drift and a short-term spike tripping our per-org rate limiter. Short-term mitigations: 1) temp increase to per-org QPS for 24h, 2) provide strict schema example + validation helper, 3) perform a canary credential rotate if token errors persist. I can do (1) if CS signs off.

olivia_csm: Comms plan draft: (A) immediate status message acknowledging and proposing a 30m call within 60m, (B) apply mitigations during the call (temporary QPS bump + schema guidance), (C) follow-up email with remediation steps and timeline. If unresolved after 24h, escalate to Director CS & Eng and notify Renewals.

mia_cs: Proposed schedule: triage call 15:30 PT (in ~50m). @raj_se please plan to join. @tom_support attach full logs to INC-2026-221 and enable `org_debug` for 12h.

tom_support: Done: logs attached and `enable_org_debug HC-77 --ttl=12h` executed. Notified sales for visibility.

raj_se: I granted a temporary QPS bump: `set_org_quota HC-77 --qps=300 --duration=24h` (was 80). Also prepared validation snippet we can paste in the call.

mia_cs: Validation snippet to send to customer after call:
```
const validateZip = (zip) => /^(\d{5})(-\d{4})?$/.test(zip);
// ensure `patient.address.zip` is string and matches regex
```

olivia_csm: Draft status short message to customer:
"Hi Jordan 0000we see two things: a schema mismatch on your uploads and a temporary spike hitting rate limits. We're scheduling a 30m troubleshooting call at 15:30 PT to walk through a corrected payload sample, apply a temporary rate increase, and rotate credentials if needed. We'll follow up with a summary and next steps. - Olivia, CSM"

mia_cs: Call notes (post-bridge): confirmed schema mismatch for `patient.address.zip` (numeric vs string). Per-org spike due to parallel job retries. Performed canary credential rotate and validated on a test workspace. Temp QPS bump active. Customer retried the first failed batch and succeeded.

tom_support: Marking INC-2026-221 as P1 and notifying sales-rep re: upcoming renewal. Also flagged potential ask for a one-time credit if onboarding delays persist.

raj_se: Monitoring KV/ingest metrics; recommend switching their org to `ingest-mode=throttle` for next 48h to flatten retries and avoid further rate kicks. I'll apply if CS approves.

mia_cs: Approved to apply throttle for 48h: `set_org_ingest_mode HC-77 --mode=throttle --duration=48h`. Action items: 1) CS monitor health dashboards for 72h, 2) send customer validated payload sample + small test harness, 3) schedule follow-up technical hardening session next week.

olivia_csm: I'll draft the follow-up email and include a short guide for the validation helper and recommended retry backoff. Also will add a note to Renewals: account stable but on-watch; recommend a 1:1 check-in if any further regressions.

mia_cs: Update: post-mitigation success. Errors dropped from ~38% -> ~1.5% after the changes and the customer confirmed successful end-to-end test. Keeping INC-2026-221 open for monitoring; will close after 72h stable. :white_check_mark:
